headline: U.S. crude oil tops $100 again – last seen in May – as market braces for prolonged Iran war
detail: Higher oil prices fuel inflation, increasing the likelihood of sustained high interest rates. This creates a tougher environment for growth stocks like your tech/chip holdings and raises margin costs.
rec: Consider trimming some general market exposure like SPY or QQQ to reduce overall portfolio risk in this inflationary environment.

headline: European Central Bank hikes interest rates to 2.5% as policymakers see risk of higher inflation, weaker growth
detail: This signals a global trend of tightening monetary policy to combat inflation. Higher rates generally depress valuations for growth stocks, impacting your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: No direct trade, but this reinforces the need for caution and vigilance on your tech positions.

headline: Apple makes biggest change to iPhone release cadence in 7 years in Ternus' first showcase as CEO
